# Build an App For Your Team

In this article, we will introduce the process of creating and releasing a SeaTalk Open Platform app (SOP app for short) for your team. There are 4 steps to be done:

1. **Create an app**
2. **Enable capabilities**
3. **App development and capability configuration**
4. **Releasing your app**

# Step 1: Create An App

From [open.seatalk.io](open.seatalk.io), click on "Start building" or "Create app" to trigger the app creation wizard. You can also trigger this by clicking "Create app" from you app list. Follow the steps in the wizard to complete the basic configuration of your app.

Step 1: Basic app information

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Step 2: Service and data scope configuration

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Upon confirmation, you will be automatically redirected to your app's profile page.

# Step 2: **Enable capabilities**

Your new app will have a default status of Not Configured. [Learn more about app statuses.](https://open.test.seatalk.io/docs/SOP-App-Statuses) To make your app usable, enable some capabilities to it by navigating to the Capabilities section on the app profile page.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Once a capability is successfully enabled, it will appear in the menu on the left hand side of the page, and you will be directed to the capability configuration menu of the newly added capability. Additionally, default API permissions for the capability will be enabled for your app. You can view these in the Scopes & Permissions tab in the menu (further details below).

# Step 3: **App development and capability configuration**

On the app's detail page, you will see the following options on the left menu tab:

1. **General Setting**: your app's Basic Info & Credentials, Collaborators, and Scopes & Permissions settings
2. **Bot** (If you selected Bot capability): settings specific to Bot
3. **Workspace App** (If you selected Workspace App capability): settings specific to Workspace App
4. **Login with SeaTalk** (If you selected Login with SeaTalk capability): settings specific to Login with SeaTalk
5. **Advanced Settings**: Event Callback and Security Settings

For different app capabilities and their respective development process, here is a [comparison between them](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/understand-app-capabilities), you can also find more guidance for each individual capability here:

1. Bot: [Quickly build a Bot](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/quickly-build-a-bot)
2. Workspace App - RN App: [Build SeaTalk RN App](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/rn-sdk-guide_get-started)
3. Workspace App - Web App: [Build SeaTalk Web App](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/functions_get-started)
4. Login with SeaTalk: [Allow user to login using SeaTalk account](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/login-with-seatalk-overview)

Follow the steps in each of the documents above to configure relevant capabilities and test by yourself.

# Step 4: Release Your App to More Audiences

Before releasing your app to your target audience, you need to apply for Scopes & Permission for your app. Here are some important things you should take note of before releasing your app:

1. **Service Scope**: Controls who can see and use your app on SeaTalk
2. **Data Scope**: Controls whose data your app can get from server APIs
3. **API Permission**: Controls what server APIs your app server is allowed to call

When your app is created, **you are automatically included in the app's Service Scope and Data Scope. Also, some default API Permission is granted to your app** so you can test the app right away. If you need to release your app to other employees or call more server APIs, you need to apply for more Scopes & Permissions. In the following section, we will introduce how to apply for them.

## Apply For Service Scope

Service Scope controls who can see and use your app on SeaTalk ("who does your app serve"). To apply for adjustments of Service Scope, go to the "Scopes & Permissions" tab and click "Apply for Scopes & Permissions" on the top-right corner.

In the "Service Scope" section, you should see two areas:

1. **Department**: If your target audiences come from some teams or departments, fill in the team/department info by describing their team paths using a breadcrumb format ("XX > YY > ZZ") in the textbox. **The team path should align with the HRIS profile team path instead of the SeaTalk user profile's team path**.
2. **Whitelist Employee**: If your target audiences include individual users who are not from any of the departments/teams listed, directly search with their emails and select them in the "Whitelist Employee" section.

Your Organization Admin will help to approve your request. **The Organization Admin of Sea Group will review requests at least once per working day so please wait for the approval.**

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## Apply For and Configure Data Scope

Data Scope controls whose data your app can access when calling some server APIs. In the Data Scope section, you can choose to automatically sync the departments and employees from Service Scope to Data Scope by selecting "Yes" for the "Sync from Service Scope" option, or "No" to specify different departments and employees.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

**The Organization Admin of Sea Group will review requests at least once per working day so please wait for the approval.**

## Apply For and Configure API Permission

API Permission is required for your app's back end to call a particular server API. To apply for API permissions, simply select the APIs your app needs to call by checking the check box in front of each API name in the API Permission section.

Note: The following APIs **do not** require any API Permission, so your app can call them anytime:

1. [Get App Access Token](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/get-app-access-token)
2. [Verify Single-Sign-on Token](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/verify-sso-token)
3. [Verify Login With SeaTalk Code](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/code-to-employee)

For each API, see the "Limited by" column to see whether Service Scope/Data Scope is required for an API.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

After filling up all your request info, click the "Submit" button. Your request will be sent to your Organization Admin for approval.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

**The Organization Admin of Sea Group will review requests at least once per working day so please wait for the approval**.
